sources.title: History of Nauru
sources.note: Annexation ceremony 2 October 1888 (German troops 16 April 1888), Australian capture in 1914 and control 'until 1920', Nauru Island Agreement 1919, mandate 1923 (Australia, with the UK and New Zealand as co-trustees), Japanese occupation from 26 August 1942, 1,200 Nauruans deported to Chuuk in 1943, liberation 13 September 1945, trusteeship 1947, independence 31 January 1968.

sources.title: Nauru
sources.note: Independence 31 January 1968 (Nauru Independence Act 1967), area 21 km2, capital Yaren (de facto) with coordinates, German annexation 1888, Australian capture 1914, Nauru Island Agreement 1919, mandate terms 1920 and mandate 1923, Japanese occupation from 25 August 1942 to 13 September 1945, UN trusteeship 1947.

notes: Written by oc-02-x. Two pages opened, shared with territory-of-nauru (Nauru; History of Nauru).
